messages.content: Selamat petang. Saya Tan, product manager untuk Telco Developer Platform — tenant `tnt-tdp-mys`. Kami nak launch produk API baharu untuk Number Verification API. Boleh tolong create API product dulu — nama 'Number Verify API', owner team `developer-platform`, category 'identity_verification'?
Selamat petang Encik Tan, terima kasih kerana menghubungi developer platform desk. Saya akan cipta produk API tersebut sekarang. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: create_api_product
function.arguments: {"name": "Number Verify API", "owner": {"team": "developer-platform", "email": "developer-platform@telco.my"}, "category": "identity_verification", "description": "GSMA-aligned mobile number verification API for partner identity flows", "tags": ["identity", "verification", "camara"], "versioning": {"initial_version": "v1.0"}, "visibility": "private_beta"}

messages.name: create_api_product
messages.content: {"api_product_id": "apip-numverify-57001", "name": "Number Verify API", "visibility": "private_beta", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:00:11+08:00", "version": "v1.0"}

Produk API berjaya dibuka:
- **`apip-numverify-57001`** — Number Verify API v1.0, status draft, private_beta

Seterusnya kita perlukan pricing profile. Adakah Encik sudah ada model harga dalam fikiran?

Yes — pricing tier based: 1k calls free, RM 0.05 per call dari 1001-50k, RM 0.03 per call dari 50001 ke atas. Currency MYR, billing monthly. Create profile tu dengan name 'Number Verify Tiered Q2 2026'.
Baik Encik, saya cipta profil harga.

function.name: create_pricing_profile
function.arguments: {"display_name": "Number Verify Tiered Q2 2026", "currency": "MYR", "billing_interval": "monthly", "tiers": [{"tier_id": "t1", "from": 1, "to": 1000, "price_per_unit": 0.00, "label": "Free tier (first 1k calls)"}, {"tier_id": "t2", "from": 1001, "to": 50000, "price_per_unit": 0.05, "label": "Standard tier"}, {"tier_id": "t3", "from": 50001, "to": null, "price_per_unit": 0.03, "label": "Volume tier"}], "metering_unit": "api_call", "prorated": true, "taxes": {"sst": 0.06}}

messages.name: create_pricing_profile
messages.content: {"pricing_profile_id": "pp-numverify-tiered-77001", "display_name": "Number Verify Tiered Q2 2026", "currency": "MYR", "tiers_count": 3, "status": "active", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:02:00+08:00"}

Profil harga `pp-numverify-tiered-77001` dicipta — 3 tier (free → RM 0.05 → RM 0.03), SST 6%, prorata aktif.

Seterusnya cipta monetization plan yang menghubungkan produk + profil. Adakah Encik mahu plan_type 'usage_based' atau 'hybrid'?
Plan type usage_based je. Create plan nama 'Number Verify Standard MYR', preview pricing untuk scenario 25k calls per month — saya nak confirm pengiraan sebelum publish.
Baik Encik, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

messages.name: create_monetization_plan
messages.content: {"plan_id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "api_product_id": "apip-numverify-57001", "name": "Number Verify Standard MYR", "plan_type": "usage_based", "status": "draft", "currency": "MYR", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:04:11+08:00"}

messages.name: preview_plan_pricing
messages.content: {"plan_id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "scenario": {"period": "monthly", "total_units": 25000}, "breakdown": [{"tier": "t1", "units": 1000, "amount": 0.00}, {"tier": "t2", "units": 24000, "amount": 1200.00}, {"tier": "t3", "units": 0, "amount": 0.00}], "subtotal": 1200.00, "sst": 72.00, "total": {"amount": 1272.00, "currency": "MYR"}}

Plan `plan-numverify-mys-99001` dicipta (draft).

**Preview harga untuk 25k calls/bulan:**
- 1,000 calls free
- 24,000 calls × RM 0.05 = RM 1,200.00
- Subtotal: RM 1,200.00
- SST 6%: RM 72.00
- **Total: RM 1,272.00**

Adakah Encik mahu simulate kesan tambah trial period 30 hari sebelum publish?
Yes simulate — tambah trial 30 hari, max 5k free calls. Sekali tarik metrics existing API products dalam tenant kami past 30 days untuk konteks.
Baik Encik, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

messages.name: simulate_plan_change
messages.content: {"simulation_id": "sim-plan-57-22001", "impacts": {"adoption_uplift": {"projected_new_signups_per_month": 38, "baseline": 12}, "revenue_impact": {"projected_mrr_delta": {"amount": 4800.00, "currency": "MYR"}, "trial_to_paid_conversion": 0.42}, "churn_risk": {"churn_rate_change_pct": -1.2}}, "recommendation": "trial_strongly_recommended"}

messages.name: get_plan_metrics
messages.content: {"window": {"start": "2026-04-21T00:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-21T00:00:00+08:00"}, "results": [{"api_product_id": "apip-smsapi-12001", "active_subscriptions": 184, "monthly_recurring_revenue": 22480.00, "avg_arpu": 122.17, "churn_rate": 0.034}, {"api_product_id": "apip-voiceapi-12002", "active_subscriptions": 47, "monthly_recurring_revenue": 9408.00, "avg_arpu": 200.17, "churn_rate": 0.021}]}

**Simulasi trial 30 hari (cap 5k calls):**
- Pendaftaran baru: 12 → **38/bulan** (+3.2×)
- Penukaran trial→paid: 42%
- Delta MRR unjuran: +RM 4,800
- Risiko churn: -1.2%
- **Cadangan: trial sangat disyorkan**

**Metrik produk sedia ada (30 hari):**
| Produk | Subs | MRR | ARPU | Churn |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SMS API | 184 | RM 22,480 | RM 122.17 | 3.4% |
| Voice API | 47 | RM 9,408 | RM 200.17 | 2.1% |

Kuat untuk launch dengan trial. Mahukah Encik update plan dengan trial dan minta kelulusan untuk publish?

Yes — update plan tambah trial config tu. Sekali request approval dari product director `usr-dir.product@telco.my`, urgency medium, justify uplift adoption 3x dan revenue delta. Lepas tu tambah comment audit.
Baik Encik, ketiga-tiga tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

function.name: update_monetization_plan
function.arguments: {"plan_id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "updates": {"trial": {"enabled": true, "trial_days": 30, "trial_unit_cap": 5000, "trial_action_on_cap": "throttle"}, "description": "Usage-based number verification with 30-day trial (5k free calls)"}, "reason": "Add trial per simulation sim-plan-57-22001 recommendation"}

function.name: request_plan_approval
function.arguments: {"id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "approvers": [{"user_id": "usr-dir.product@telco.my", "role": "approver", "team": "product", "level": "director"}], "justification": "Number Verify launch. Simulation: 3.2x adoption uplift, +MYR 4,800 MRR, churn -1.2pp. Plan includes 30-day trial with 5k call cap, tier pricing MYR 0.05 / 0.03.", "urgency": "medium", "actor": {"user_id": "tan.pm@telco.my", "role": "operator", "team": "developer-platform"}}

function.name: add_plan_comment
function.arguments: {"id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "body": "Trial config applied per sim-plan-57-22001. Awaiting product director approval before publish. Existing API products MRR baseline captured.", "actor": {"user_id": "tan.pm@telco.my", "role": "operator", "team": "developer-platform"}, "visibility": "internal", "tags": ["trial_added", "awaiting_approval"]}

messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-plan-57-99001", "id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "status": "pending", "approvers_pending": ["usr-dir.product@telco.my"], "sla_deadline": "2026-05-22T14:08:00+08:00"}

messages.content: {"comment_id": "cmt-plan-57-55001", "id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:08:14+08:00", "author": "tan.pm@telco.my"}

- Plan v2 dengan trial dikemas kini.
- Kelulusan `appr-plan-57-99001` pending (SLA 24 jam).
- Komen audit `cmt-plan-57-55001` direkodkan.

Sementara menunggu, mahukah Encik saya snapshot plan sekarang dan subscribe team Encik kepada lifecycle events?
Yes — snapshot, dan subscribe team `developer-platform@telco.my`. Update — director baru ping dia approve. Submit decision, lepas tu publish plan.
Baik Encik, keempat-empat tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

messages.content: {"snapshot_id": "snap-plan-57-66001", "id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "label": "pre-publish-2026-05-21", "taken_at": "2026-05-21T14:11:00+08:00", "retention_days": 730}

messages.content: {"subscription_id": "sub-plan-57-77001", "name": "Developer Platform watch for plan-numverify-mys-99001", "active": true, "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:11:01+08:00"}

messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-plan-57-99001", "status": "approved", "decided_at": "2026-05-21T14:11:02+08:00", "approver": "usr-dir.product@telco.my", "sla_met": true}

messages.content: {"plan_id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "status": "published", "published_at": "2026-05-21T14:30:00+08:00", "visibility": "private_beta", "announcement_sent": true, "plan_url": "https://developer.telco.my/plans/plan-numverify-mys-99001"}

- Snapshot `snap-plan-57-66001` direkodkan.
- Langganan `sub-plan-57-77001` aktif.
- Kelulusan approved (SLA dipenuhi).
- **Plan published** dalam mod private_beta, berkuat kuasa 2:30 petang. URL: https://developer.telco.my/plans/plan-numverify-mys-99001

Mahukah Encik saya cipta langganan ujian untuk customer pertama supaya kita verify aliran end-to-end?
Yes, create subscription untuk pilot customer kami — customer ID `cust-pilotco-001`, billing account `ba-pilotco-001`. Sekali get_plan_details untuk shareable specs kepada developer mereka.
Baik Encik, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

messages.content: {"subscription_id": "sub-numverify-pilotco-44001", "plan_id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "customer_id": "cust-pilotco-001", "status": "trialing", "started_at": "2026-05-21T15:00:00+08:00", "trial_ends_at": "2026-06-20T15:00:00+08:00", "trial_unit_cap": 5000}

messages.content: {"plan_id": "plan-numverify-mys-99001", "name": "Number Verify Standard MYR", "status": "published", "pricing": {"currency": "MYR", "tiers": [{"from": 1, "to": 1000, "price_per_unit": 0}, {"from": 1001, "to": 50000, "price_per_unit": 0.05}, {"from": 50001, "to": null, "price_per_unit": 0.03}]}, "trial": {"enabled": true, "trial_days": 30, "trial_unit_cap": 5000}, "limits": {"rate_limit_per_minute": 600, "max_concurrent_subscriptions": 1000}, "compliance": ["PDPA-MY", "GSMA-CAMARA"], "sample_payloads": {"verify_request": {"phone_number": "+60123456789", "hash": "sha256:..."}, "verify_response": {"verified": true, "confidence": 0.99}}}

- **Langganan pilot dibuka:** `sub-numverify-pilotco-44001`, status **trialing**, tamat 20 Jun 2026, cap 5,000 calls.
- **Spec plan untuk developer:**
  - Tier: 0/0.05/0.03 MYR/call
  - Rate limit: 600/minit, max 1,000 langganan serentak
  - Compliance: PDPA-MY, GSMA-CAMARA
  - Sample payload tersedia

Adakah Encik mahu saya pull status langganan untuk pastikan trialing aktif dengan baik?
Yes please, get subscription status. Sekali generate usage report untuk plan ni — scope plan_id, time range pasca-publish hingga sekarang, format json.
Baik Encik, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

- Report `rpt-usage-plan-57-88001` siap: 1 langganan, 0 calls (baru saja published). [Muat turun](https://developer.telco.my/reports/rpt-usage-plan-57-88001.json)

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi yang Encik perlukan?
Boleh schedule weekly usage report setiap Isnin pagi 8:00 MYT untuk plan ni, hantar ke `developer-platform@telco.my`? Sambil tu tarik audit log untuk plan ni.
Baik Encik, kedua-dua tindakan dijalankan secara selari.

**Audit log lengkap (7 events):**
1. 14:04:11 — plan_created
2. 14:08:11 — plan_updated (trial enabled)
3. 14:08:14 — comment_added
4. 14:11:00 — snapshot_taken
5. 14:11:02 — approval_decided (approved)
6. 14:30:00 — plan_published
7. 15:00:00 — subscription_created (sub-numverify-pilotco-44001)

Job `job-plan-weekly-rpt-57-22001` dijadual Isnin 8:00 pagi MYT, 28 larian hingga Nov 2026.

Adakah ada apa-apa lagi, Encik?
Itu sahaja, terima kasih. Saya akan monitor private beta dahulu, kalau ada isu billing nanti boleh hubungi semula untuk retry operation atau rollback. Bye.

Sila ambil maklum, Encik Tan — jika ada isu billing pada langganan ini, fungsi `retry_billing_operation` boleh dijalankan untuk transaksi gagal, dan `rollback_plan_change` boleh restore ke snapshot `snap-plan-57-66001` jika diperlukan. Pasukan kami akan terima notifikasi automatik melalui langganan `sub-plan-57-77001`.

Ringkasan launch:
- Produk **Number Verify API** dipublish dalam private_beta dengan plan **Number Verify Standard MYR**
- Pilot subscription pertama berjaya dibuat untuk pilotco
- Snapshot, dashboard implisit melalui report, audit log, dan job mingguan semua aktif

Terima kasih atas kerjasama. Selamat sejahtera dan selamat berjaya dengan launch private beta.
